description: Type text into the computer, like a player at the keyboard, and return "ok" at once without waiting for the program. Prefer craftos_act with text, which also waits until the program read it and the screen settled; use this one to type ahead or into a program that is busy.

enter.description: Press Enter after the text (default true).

text.description: Characters to type, as char events.

name: craftos_type
